title: Fix MD060 table-column-style violations and re-enable the rule
description: markdownlint-cli2 v0.21.0 introduced MD060/table-column-style which flags compact markdown tables missing spaces around pipes. There are 228 violations across existing markdown files (mostly in doc/archive/blunder-approach-comparison.md). We disabled MD060 in .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc to unblock the dependency update. Need to fix the table formatting and re-enable the rule.
